incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTOR: realtime-p99-detector tripped for /v1/stream generate. 10m p99=2.1s (target=0.9s). paging eng-sre oncall.
Alex G: Oncall answering. Pulling up the live latency dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/live-realtime
Maria C: I'm seeing an uptick in streaming stalls and partial responses. Tail latency concentrated on requests with context > 1500 tokens.
Samir: PD INC-2026-2201 created and paged. Marking P1 for now until we confirm blast radius.
Priya (ops): Support reports 4 enterprise customers in eu-west experiencing degraded streaming sessions. Not widespread but customers hit SLOs.
Alex G: Quick infra checks: `kubectl describe pod -n inference realtime-xxxxx` - no OOMs, nodes report healthy.
Infra SRE: Runtime metrics show tokenizer queue depth increasing and a KV cache miss spike. KV hit rate down from 82% -> 35% over last 12m on pool C.
Maria C: That drop could explain stalls — more recompute and cache churn. Any recent rollout?
Infra SRE: Yes, canary deploy model-2.2-int8 to pool C about 30m ago, canary size 15%.
Samir: We should isolate canary traffic. Suggest routing canary off pool C to pool D and see if latencies improve.
Alex G: Executing routing override: `POST /admin/routing` {"from_pool":"pool-C","to_pool":"pool-D","pct":100} -> initiated.
incident-bot: routing-change initiated by Alex G.
Maria C: After routing change, short-request p99 drops near target, but long-sequence p99 still ~1.6s. Looks like kernel degradation for long contexts.
Infra SRE: Profiling shows increased syscalls and lock contention inside the attention kernel for sequences > 2048 on model-2.2-int8 path. Repro available on benchmark node.
Priya (ops): Support update sent to customers: "We've detected increased tail latency affecting long-context sessions. We're routing traffic and running mitigations. Will follow up with RCA."
Samir: Mitigations in parallel: 1) add fallback variant for sequences > 1200 to model-2.1-quant-fast; 2) reduce streaming inflight windows to limit concurrent tails; 3) scale pool D by +2 nodes.
Alex G: Applying fallback policy: `runtime policy add if seq_len > 1200 then model=model-2.1-quant-fast` -> applied. Adjusting streaming inflight: `runtime set streaming.max_inflight 6 -> 3` -> applied. Triggering autoscale override for pool D +2 nodes.
Maria C: Observing immediate reduction in stream stalls and tail p99 moves to ~1.02s for long contexts. Overall p99 now ~0.95s.
Infra SRE: Collected perf traces and logs for kernel path. Excerpt: 
``
2026-04-12T16:22:45Z runtime[req=ef12b] attention_kernel lock_wait=1823ms seq_len=3072 model=model-2.2-int8
2026-04-12T16:22:46Z cache[hit=false] key=session:ctx:ef12b last_access=20m
``
Samir: Customer impact estimate: ~0.6% of requests, concentrated in enterprise long-chat exports. SLA exposure moderate-high.
Priya (ops): Recommending keeping fallbacks and scaled capacity for 60m while we validate kernel patch. Also suggest adding a seq_len dimension to p99 detectors to split alerts by context size.
Alex G: Incident doc INC-2026-2201 created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-2201 (owner: Alex G). Mitigation status: in progress.
Support Bot: Support update logged and customers notified of mitigation and pending RCA.
Maria C: Actions: 1) postmortem owner: Maria C, draft due 36h; 2) infra: kernel fix PR with microbenchmarks (Infra SRE); 3) deploy gating: add long-seq synthetic smoke test to canary job; 4) alerting: add seq_len buckets to p99 detector (Samir).
Infra SRE: Working on kernel patch and will attach perf artifacts to PR.
Alex G: Leaving routing override in place for 45m, then will slowly revert if stable.
Samir: Also adding an ephemeral alarm to catch any model-variant canary regressions over seq>1024 for next 24h.
Priya (ops): Support will send follow-up to customers in 2h with mitigation summary.
incident-bot: Status UPDATE: MITIGATED - initial mitigations reduced p99 below SLO for most traffic. Monitoring for stabilization 30m before close.
Alex G: Thanks team — wrapping live mitigation. Will post when RCA draft is ready. :white_check_mark:
